|lore=Sand People use a special mask to reclaim exhaled moisture in the hot, harsh environment of Tatooine. Protects by filtering blowing sand and dispersing excess heat.
|game_text=Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your total ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.

|notes=The Players Committee announced the errata to this card, effective 17 September 2007, with two downloads: a separate errata sheet and the re-issued Virtual Set 8 sheet, which it said “will have the updated text”.<ref name="pc-errata-20070917-news" /> The two print different wordings. The errata sheet (this article) and the Holotable card image say “…if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your total ability during battle at a site.” The set sheet says “…your total ability during battle at a site is +X” ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (Revised 2007)|Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Revised 2007)]]). {{Mystery|question=Which of the two 17 September 2007 wordings was the official text|section=Which 17 September 2007 wording of Tusken Breath Mask (V) was official?|type=card}}
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf] (Players Committee errata sheet, “Errata: September 17, 2007”, PDF dated 14 September 2007; Internet Archive 26 October 2007), page 1, slip 22. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
